description: Recorded VictoriaLogs responses for the loader's log filters (ADR-016 §2, §4): level, conversation_id and a text search beside the time range and module. Records were inserted through the collector insert protocol; every response was captured verbatim. Field filters use the exact-match form field:="value"; the text search uses the phrase form _msg:"value". The last three exchanges are the escaping cases: for a quote-and-OR value the adapter sends the escaped phrase (no match) while the unescaped form a naive concatenation would send matches two records; the third is a crafted value with quotes, a backslash and a pipe, sent escaped and matched literally.

exchanges.name: range

request.query: _time:[2026-11-07T10:00:00.000Z, 2026-11-07T11:00:00.000Z] | sort by (_time desc, _msg desc, pod desc) | offset 0 | limit 200
